values.content: You are an expert coaching assistant. Your task is to prepare concise, helpful session preparation notes for a coach based on client information and upcoming session details.

parameters.subject: =Confirmation: Your Coaching Session on {{new Date($node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["startTime"]).toLocaleDateString()}}
parameters.html:
=

Your Coaching Session is Confirmed

Hello {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["firstName"]}},

This email confirms your upcoming coaching session:

Date & Time: {{new Date($node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["startTime"]).toLocaleString()}}

Duration: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["sessionDuration"]}}

Location: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["location"]}}

Coaching Type: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["coachingType"]}}

Please make sure to:

  • Find a quiet, private space for our session
  • Have a notebook and pen ready
  • Test your audio/video if we're meeting online
  • Come prepared with any questions or topics you'd like to discuss

If you need to reschedule, please do so at least 24 hours in advance.

I'm looking forward to our session!

Best regards,
Your Coach

This is an automated message. Please do not reply directly to this email.

parameters.subject: =New Client Added: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["fullName"]}}
parameters.html:
=

New Client Added to Database

A new client has been automatically added to your client database:

Name: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["fullName"]}}

Email: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["email"]}}

Phone: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["phone"]}}

Coaching Type: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["coachingType"]}}

First Session: {{$node["Code - Match Client Data"].json["sessionDateTime"]}}

This client was automatically added because they scheduled a session but were not found in your existing client database.

You may want to:

  • Update their information in your client database
  • Send them a welcome email or onboarding materials
  • Prepare for their first session

Best regards,
Your Coaching Automation System
